This acquisition is a major consolidation within the human capital management (HCM) industry, combining two leading providers of payroll, HR, and benefits solutions. The deal is expected to enhance Paychex's offerings, particularly for mid-market and enterprise clients, and expand its suite of AI-driven HR technology. The combination boosts Paychex's total addressable market from $90 billion to over $100 billion and is anticipated to yield over $80 million in annual cost synergies.
